correctness.rationale: The estimator error identity is exact: each summand is a centered Bernoulli variable multiplied by a coefficient \(d_i/[\pi_i(1-\pi_i)]\), where \(d_i=(1-\pi_i)Y_i(1)+\pi_iY_i(0)-m_i\). The attainable set of \(d_i\) is exactly the interval \([a_i-m_i,b_i-m_i]\), and convexity of the Bernoulli log-mgf in \(d_i\) puts the worst case at an endpoint. Independence makes the supremum separable. Reflection through the unitwise midpoint exchanges upper and lower endpoint deviations, so convexity of the two-sided envelope proves pointwise midpoint minimaxity. At the all-upper-endpoint configuration the variance is exactly \(V_n\); the no-dominant-unit condition \(M_n/\sqrt{V_n}	o0\) implies Lindeberg and yields the claimed endpoint CLT.
